name: Enterprise Portfolio Selection and Allocation
constraints: Portfolio profiles WM-ACT-029 with the mandatory discriminator and remains distinct from Program, catalogue, Project and Initiative.
PortfolioComponent, Prioritization, InvestmentAllocation and PortfolioScenario are addressable effective-dated portfolio-owned releases.
Membership never transfers component mastership and one component may belong to multiple portfolios with independently declared shares.
Portfolio allocation is intent within an approved envelope and remains distinct from authority, commitment, actual and component funding.
Scenario is an immutable hypothesis release and becomes no baseline without a separate authorized decision and issued record.
Rebalance creates successor composition and allocation releases and preserves prior criteria, ranking, allocation and decision history.
